description: This source file defines a utility enum 'CritterIconRenderer' responsible for generating critter icons with customizable features such as face expressions, badge overlays, and eye states. It contains nested structs for managing geometry, face options, and drawing routines, and includes functions to produce NSImage icons with various visual configurations.

methods.name: makeIcon
methods.description: Creates an NSImage icon of a critter with customizable face features, blinking, badges, and ear/wiggle parameters.

methods.name: makeBitmapRep
methods.description: Creates a bitmap representation for rendering the icon, ensuring crisp display on Retina screens.

methods.name: makeCanvas
methods.description: Initializes the drawing canvas with coordinate snapping for crisp rendering.

methods.name: drawBody
methods.description: Draws the critter's body, ears, and legs.

methods.name: drawFace
methods.description: Draws the face, eyes, and eye details based on specified options.

methods.name: drawBadge
methods.description: Draws a badge overlay with specified prominence and symbol.
